summary: After a strong-cue wake, a date or time said again in the same conversation no longer wakes the unit again straight away; only an RSVP or a place link does, and the rest waits for the room to settle.
details: A conversation that kept mentioning times used to wake a full session after every pause; a synthetic 2h13m afternoon went from 27 wakes to 3.
limitations: A keep instruction no longer re-arms a strong-cue wake either; it waits for the room to settle.
